title: Newark unconscionable rent increase ordinance
requirement: A landlord may not impose an unconscionable rent increase on residential properties; a court finding that a rent increase was unconscionable, or a history of unconscionable increases, is treated as tenant displacement.

coverage_quotes: UNCONSCIONABLE RENT — Shall mean any rental increase for residential properties

quoted_span: DISPLACEMENT BY FACT — Shall mean a tenant is displaced by Landlord due to an increase in rent, and the eviction proceeding has been adjudicated by a court of competent jurisdiction and has been determined that such increase was unconscionable.
